description: A persistent interactive session: the app launches once and stays up for a tap → inspect loop. action `start` launches an installed iOS/Android app, an owned web URL, or the workspace's managed web target (pass `focus` to reach a named screen first); then one action per call: `login` (email+password or `actor` — fills, submits and verifies in one call; prefer it over manual typing), `tap` (id/label or x/y), `type` (text, optional id — replaces the field), `swipe`, `back`, `wait` (for id/text), `tree` (re-inspect; full:true for every raw element), `screenshot`; `save_flow` writes the recorded steps as a replayable Flow; `draft_flow` has a model write a Flow from `goal` grounded in observed screens (untrusted proposal; needs a model backend); `end` quits the app — always call it when done. One session at a time; starts from a cold launch, so plan a `login` first when the app gates on sign-in. Ask the user before typing into fields you have no values for.

addFinalAssertion.description: save_flow: append assert_screen for the final screen
